name: Advertisement track
description: Advertisement statistics tracker allowing to count advertisement impressions and clicks locally.
project_description: Advertisement track is the native statistics-tracker submodule of the Advertisement (ad) project. It provides two tracker plugins (immediate local and queue/cron-based local), an ad_track_event entity plus an ad_track_total denormalized counter table, a click-tracking redirect route, granular tracking settings, and Views integration (including a click-through-rate field) for reporting on advertisement impressions and clicks.
